positive.sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT d.CustomerId, MONTH(d.DocumentDate) AS m, SUM(d.NetAmount) AS net FROM SalesDocument d WHERE d.IsCanceled = 0 AND d.DocumentDate >= '2026-01-01' AND d.DocumentDate < '2026-03-01' GROUP BY d.CustomerId, MONTH(d.DocumentDate)) SELECT c.CustomerName, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.m = 1 THEN m.net END), 0), 2) AS jan_net_amount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.m = 2 THEN m.net END), 0), 2) AS feb_net_amount FROM monthly m JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = m.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.CustomerName ORDER BY c.CustomerName
